notes.title: Palworld 1.0 is live
notes.summary: Pocketpair ships the full 1.0 release after Early Access: 72 new Pals, Sunreach floating islands, the World Tree endgame route, level cap 80, and major partner-skill / combat overhauls. Existing saves carry forward.

body.text: Palworld left Early Access on July 10, 2026. Pocketpair framed 1.0 as a full launch rather than a polish patch: new regions, dozens of Pals, and systems that reshuffle endgame parties and base lineups.

items: 72 additional Pals (new species and elemental variants)
Sunreach floating islands and the World Tree endgame route
Work suitability scaled toward Level 10 with condenser changes

body.text: For toolkit users: expect combat and worker tier placements to move as Awakening, Mutation, and the new legendaries settle into community comps.

notes.title: 1.0 patch notes nearly broke Steam’s character limit
notes.summary: Publishing lead John “Bucky” Buckley said the 1.0 changelog ran past 10,000 words / ~66k characters — over Steam’s 32k limit — then confirmed they published the full notes “without making any compromise.”

body.text: The day before launch, Pocketpair’s publishing lead posted that the 1.0 changelog would not fit Steam’s announcement character cap. The draft reportedly cleared 10,000 words and roughly double Steam’s 32k-character limit.

A follow-up confirmed the full notes went live without cutting content. Treat that Steam post as the canonical “what changed” document for balance, partner skills, and systems — not third-party summaries alone.

notes.title: Feybreak v0.4.11 — new island and pals
notes.summary: Major Early Access expansion adding Feybreak Island, new Pals, buildings, and systems. Sets up later endgame progression that 1.0 continues to expand.

body.text: Feybreak was one of the largest Early Access content drops: a new island, additional Pals, buildings, and systems that pushed the map and progression beyond the original Palpagos loop.
1.0 still leans on that expansion’s geography and roster. If you are returning from a long break, treat Feybreak as the mid-EA checkpoint before Sunreach and the World Tree.

notes.title: Sakurajima v0.3.1 — new area and buildings
notes.summary: Sakurajima update lands with a new region, additional Pals, and expanded base building — one of the largest mid-EA content drops before Feybreak.

body.text: Sakurajima introduced a new region, more Pals, and a wider building kit. It remains relevant in 1.0 for meteor events (Selyne) and mid-game progression routes that feed into later islands.

notes.title: Partner skills: most duplicates no longer stack
notes.summary: In 1.0, almost all identical partner-skill auras do not stack from multiple copies of the same Pal. Gobfin / Gobfin Ignis Angry Shark is a notable exception that still stacks for player-weapon builds; Orserk’s bullet ramp stacks with itself up to 30 times on the active Pal.

body.text: Pocketpair reworked partner skills on more than 200 Pals for 1.0. The headline balance rule: for almost all species, putting multiple copies of the same Pal in the party no longer multiplies the same aura.

items: Gobfin / Gobfin Ignis Angry Shark still stacks for player Attack — classic weapon parties remain viable
Orserk’s Ferocious Thunder Dragon ramps Attack/Defense on the active Pal from bullet hits, stacking up to 30 times with itself
Diverse five-species parties are the default for most other auras

body.text: Build parties around distinct roles (ramp, weakness DPS, heal, mount) unless you are intentionally running a Gobfin weapon stack.

notes.title: Base price stays $29.99 for 1.0
notes.summary: Pocketpair confirmed Palworld keeps its standard $29.99 price at 1.0 launch. Launch window also included a short Steam discount for new buyers.

body.text: Despite the scale of the 1.0 update, Pocketpair kept the standard store price at $29.99. Early Access owners get the update as part of ownership; new buyers saw a short launch discount window on Steam.
No gameplay systems are locked behind a price bump — the toolkit here tracks the same free 1.0 content everyone receives.
